pages.text: Find a village notice board. Pick an offer and wait for the hunt area to be prepared. Regular offers rotate every three in-game days. An accepted contract stays active. Follow the HUD.

Toggle Witcher Senses (V by default) near the search area. Inspect two clues in order. The second reveals the lair; approach it to encounter the target. Defeat it to finish the hunt and earn crowns. To cancel: /wbcontract abandon.
